title: Hyundai Motor Group sets up a robotics business strategy team
key_facts: Hyundai Motor Group has launched an 'RX Business Strategy Team' under its Future Business Strategy Division through a restructuring, according to industry sources on 15 Oct 2026.
RX is defined by the group as 'Robotics Everything'.
The Robotics Lab handles the wearable robot ExBr Shoulder and the mobile platform Moved; affiliate Boston Dynamics handles Atlas and Spot.
The team's top priority is expected to be efficient production and deployment of Atlas and building external sales channels.
Atlas is scheduled for production from 2028, for Hyundai's US car plants and later sale to other automakers.
quote_evidence: Hyundai Motor Group has launched a dedicated organization to formulate its global robotics business strategy.
The top priority for the RX Business Strategy Team is expected to be securing efficient production and practical deployment of Atlas, as well as establishing external sales channels.
Atlas, scheduled for production starting in 2028, is planned for deployment at Hyundai Motor Group's U.S. automotive plants
why_it_matters_hint: Shows Hyundai organising to turn its robots, especially Atlas, into a business.
notes: Exclusive from industry sources; article is machine-translated from Korean.
